assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Create local validation MCP servers for 192.168.50.4:8765 and :8766
steps.expected: Both servers register/reinitialize so no-input and open-object schemas can be validated
steps.observed: Both create calls returned 403 MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED; reinitialize/connection checks returned 404.

steps.action: Run schedule probes that target the intended local MCP servers
steps.expected: Schedules execute with requested MCP servers bound
steps.observed: Stored schedule targets normalized to ephemeralAgent.mcp=[] due missing servers, so callable-path evidence is not valid for local-surface assertions.

assertions.issues: Blocked by MCP domain policy rejecting both local validation servers (403 MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED).

assertions.title: OAuth refresh prefers protected-resource authorization server metadata

steps.action: Create and reinitialize Arcade OAuth MCP server
steps.expected: Reach a state where expired-token refresh behavior can be exercised
steps.observed: Server creation/reinitialize succeeded, but OAuth status stayed PENDING with no auth-value flags.

steps.action: Probe runtime logs for refresh prerequisites
steps.observed: Logs show access token missing and no refresh token available, requiring re-authentication instead of refresh.

assertions.issues: Blocked: no credentialed OAuth refresh-state persona/token exists in this partition (status remained PENDING).

assertions.title: OAuth callback URLs preserve precedence rules across local and proxied deployments

steps.action: Reinitialize Arcade OAuth server without forwarded headers

steps.observed: Forwarded reinitialize returned success:false with oauthUrl=null, so forwarded precedence could not be validated.

steps.action: Probe /oauth/initiate directly and with forwarded headers
steps.observed: Both initiate calls returned 403 User mismatch in API-token flow.

assertions.issues: Blocked: forwarded precedence branch did not yield usable oauthUrl evidence from available API flow state.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Initialize Arcade server in pending-consent state and inspect MCP tools surface
steps.observed: Server appeared in /api/mcp/tools but tools array was empty before consent.

steps.action: Invoke pending-consent MCP target through scheduled execution
steps.expected: Continuation metadata (authorization_url and/or llm_instructions) is surfaced
steps.observed: Run failed with explicit OAuth-consent-required message but no authorization_url/llm_instructions metadata in response payload.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent path now fails correctly, but required continuation metadata/tool-listing contract was not met in this user-surface run.

assertions.title: Scheduled MCP and OAuth execution keeps the interactive auth contract

steps.action: Manual Run now for pending-consent Arcade MCP schedule
steps.expected: Durable auth failure with no success conversation
steps.observed: POST /run returned 500; schedule persisted lastStatus=failed with explicit OAuth-consent-required error and no conversation IDs.

steps.action: Background scheduler run for enabled pending-consent Arcade MCP schedule
steps.expected: Same durable auth failure behavior in scheduler path
steps.observed: Background poll showed lastTriggeredBy=scheduler, lastStatus=failed, explicit OAuth-consent-required error, and no conversation IDs.
